paletteRoles.ink: Graphite typography and structural outlines on warm/light/lime fields.
paletteRoles.night: Deep midnight architectural ground for cover, system loop, photo atlas, target and reference pages.
paletteRoles.paper: Warm editorial paper; main thesis, requirements, plan and evidence spread ground.
paletteRoles.mist: Cool neutral observation/learning ground; not a low-contrast border.
paletteRoles.accent: Electric lime focal mass, selected route on night, attention/current chapter; never a pass or learning-gain signal.
paletteRoles.accentInk: Dark olive partner for lime and light-ground emphasis, not a second vivid accent.
paletteRoles.lineLight: Meaningful route/relationship strokes on paper/mist/accent; not light-ground text.
paletteRoles.lineDark: Meaningful route/relationship strokes on night/ink; not light-ground strokes.

approachesConsidered.tradeoff: Grounds the atlas in the real station but produces mostly gray/cyan and no deliberate editorial focal color; retained as neutral reference, not copied wholesale.

approachesConsidered.approach: Constraint-led tonal anchors plus electric lime
approachesConsidered.tradeoff: Selected: source-derived graphite/mist character, contract warm paper/night anchors, one high-chroma attention color; separate light/dark text and line tokens meet explicit thresholds.

paletteDevelopment.selection: Do not claim lime was sampled from station photos. Palette anchors ink/night/paper/mist/accent/accentInk follow the approved direction; extracted neutrals support scene compatibility. New muted/line tokens were chosen by numerical readability, not old blue-token renaming.
paletteDevelopment.semanticAdaptation: This is a proposal atlas, not an application status theme. No invented success/error/chart colors or incident taxonomy. Sequence is encoded by labels, arrows and node shape; planned versus current is written explicitly.

contrastMatrix.method: WCAG 2.x sRGB relative luminance; channel <=0.04045 divides by 12.92, else ((channel+0.055)/1.055)^2.4; coefficients 0.2126/0.7152/0.0722; (Llighter+0.05)/(Ldarker+0.05). Full opacity only.
prohibited: No accent text/connector directly on paper or mist: 1.1304 / 1.0188. Use accentInk lettering and ink outline around lime nodes.
No lineDark on light fields: paper 2.8850, mist 2.6003, accent 2.5523.
No lineLight as light-ground caption text: paper 4.1685, mist 3.7572, accent 3.6878. Use muted instead.
No muted on night/ink; no mutedOnNight on paper/mist/accent.
No text on unmeasured photographic pixels, alpha-reduced lines, or boundaries between paper/mist/accent without a contrasting ink edge.

coverLatin.usage: CHOOGuard project identity on cover only; do not repeat as a generic giant heading

displayKorean.usage: Short thesis on cover and effect keywords only; at most two lines

headline.usage: Korean main thesis, explicit semantic line groups from layout plan; at most two lines

body.usage: Primary explanation; 18–28 Hangul characters per line as an initial measure, not a glyph-width guarantee

bodyEmphasis.usage: Short response principles or current/target distinctions; same size as body, not another enlarged role

graphicLabel.usage: Diagram stops, stage names and concise relationship labels

caption.usage: Source, actual-image captions, readable URL labels and attribution

chapterIndex.usage: 01–06 narrative index; REF for reference page, never emergency counts

wordmark.usage: CHOOGuard exact spelling, no pseudo-logo replacement

routeLabel.usage: Six topics, unselected labels retain readable contrast

routeActive.usage: Selected route label; underline and filled node supplement color

technicalLabel.usage: JEV, Unity and other Latin technical labels

basis.selection: Quantize role sizes and line heights to the fixed-slide rhythm; 24 captions, 28 compact labels, 32 body and 40 sections. Editorial headlines and cover are deliberate display exceptions, not wholesale type enlargement. Reuse 24/28/32/40/72 for routine pages.

scriptRules: Noto Sans KR owns Korean runs, including punctuation next to Korean. Inter owns standalone Latin editorial identifiers/numerals. Do not let Inter silently supply Korean glyphs.
Use exact Black/Bold/Regular styles listed in the contract; no synthetic emboldening. Data lookup supports family choice; contract supplies Figma style availability, not local render evidence.
Body Korean tracking is 0. Display Korean is at most -1% and must preserve readable syllable spacing. Wider +4% is reserved for Latin uppercase chapter identifiers.
Keep supplied headline line breaks and semantic chunks; no arbitrary syllable split, auto shrinking, horizontal scaling, full justification or forced widows.
Body block normally 2–4 short lines; source captions remain >=24px. Preserve meaning by reflow, not copy deletion. Highlight one short phrase rather than making every word Bold.

deliveryScaling.native: 1920×1080 fixed editorial canvas, no mobile UI breakpoint pretend-workflow.
deliveryScaling.1280x720: Scale whole composition uniformly by 2/3; body is 21.33px and caption 16px on output, preserving hierarchy. Do not selectively enlarge or shrink text to fit.
deliveryScaling.smallPreview: Preview is not a reading delivery format. Provide full-resolution slides or a separate accessible reading document owned by parent if needed.

typography.evidenceLevel: Authored role system and installed typography-data lookup. Final glyph coverage, actual Figma font selection, baseline, wrap and projection readability are not verified by this slice.

elements.name: chapterIndex
elements.treatment: filled index block using indexFill/indexText; centered text, no fake symbol

header.semanticRule: Index is proposal chapter, not page or emergency count. Reference page uses REF / 참고자료 / REFERENCES; does not invent chapter 07.
header.photoPages: Header stays on a solid night ground, outside the photographic crop.

footer.kind: Six-topic route navigator + active chapter label + folio

route.meaning: All six actual proposal topics remain labeled. No completed/uncompleted states, percentages, pass ticks or extra stops. The filled larger node and bold underline identify reader position, not progress performance.

footer.referenceVariant: Keep the six-topic route with every node outlined, no seventh active node. Chapter readout is 참고자료; folio 13 / 13.
footer.coverVariant: Chapter 01 is selected; route labels remain readable while cover identity is the dominant information.
footer.lightAccentRule: Lime-filled header block has ink lettering. Lime route nodes on paper/mist require ink boundary; default route uses dark accentInk instead.

graphicRules.massing: Use page ground as a full-bleed major field, not a small tint around white cards. Cover may use a large lime plane behind station cutout; slide 11 intentionally uses full lime ground. Night atlas pages retain actual image colors.
graphicRules.accentCoverage: Typically 5–12% attention mass on paper/mist/night pages, 15–25% on cover; slide 11 is intentional full-ground reversal. These are composition targets, not measured output percentages.
graphicRules.meaningfulConnectors: Full-opacity strokes >=4px at 1920, visible arrowheads >=12px; use approvedConnectorPairs. Junction/outline must contrast with BOTH adjacent fills; ink edge separates lime from paper/mist. No light tint connectors mistaken for accessible structure.
graphicRules.photoText: Text only on an opaque night/paper plate or outside photos. Do not imply chosen token contrast proves text on arbitrary photo pixels. Keep source footage ungraded and disclose concept/current/target.
graphicRules.hierarchy: One dominant thesis or visual per slide. Body Regular vs short Bold emphasis, concise labels and source captions; huge numerals only for actual chapter/milestone information. No recurring three-box template.
graphicRules.boundaries: No shadow, gradient, arbitrary colored ribbon or fake KPI. Route geometry means topic order; diagrams mean actual dependencies. A repeated process glyph cannot stand for a fixed incident kind.
